slot_scores.name: no_production_during_training_period
slot_scores.evidence_quote: While a skilled worker is training a batch of trainees, can that skilled worker still produce food (at the normal 10 kg/h or 6 kg/h rate), or is the skilled worker fully occupied with training and produces nothing during those two weeks?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the trainer can produce during training, directly covering the hidden slot's key meaning.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize total cost (labor wages + overtime + late-delivery compensation), or is there a different objective (e.g., maximize profit, minimize total hours, etc.)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is to minimize total cost.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 hidden slots were resolved by turn 19, but the agent continued with repeated identical questions about trainer pay in turns 24-30, which is low-value over-questioning.

summary: The agent recovered both hidden slots, including the P0 objective and P1 training-production constraint, but then repeated the same already-answered trainer-pay question many times, showing poor stopping behavior.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
